name: tools-livesplit-kaizo-v1-0
title: LiveSplit.Kaizo v1.0.6
description:
A LiveSplit Kaizo Autosplitter!

This .asl-file will take care of your splits automatically while speedrunning.
The splits will always be at the same time (usually either on the whistle or on Mario's victory sign) and you
won't have to worry about forgetting to split or splitting twice accidentally.


What do you need?
• LiveSplit
• One of the supported devices
• One of the supported hacks
• Splits for this hack



Installation


• In Livesplit -> Edit Layout…
• Add -> Control -> Scriptable Auto Splitter
• Layout Settings (lower left corner) -> choose tab 'Scriptable Auto Splitter'
• Script Path is the path to the file 'Livesplit.Kaizo.asl'
• Check on 'Start', 'Split', 'Reset', 'Normal Levels', 'Boss Levels', and 'Switch Palaces'
• Go
• Attention: For a hack to be recognized correctly, the correct Game Name has to be set in LiveSplit (Best done with Autocomplete in 'Edit Splits...')


Supported Devices

By now the splitter only works on emulators (support for other devices will be added if available to me) and should work with these emulators and versions:

Retroarch (Snes9x Core)
Snes9x-rr 1.60
Snes9x-rr 1.60 (x64)
Snes9x 1.60
Snes9x 1.60 (x64)
higan v106
higan v106.112
higan v107
higan v108
higan v109
higan v110
bsnes v107
bsnes v107.1
bsnes v107.2/107.3
bsnes v110
bsnes v111
bsnes v112
bsnes v115
BizHawk 2.3

BizHawk 2.3.2

Supported Hacks

LiveSplit.Kaizo does not work on all hacks and has to be adjusted individually for other hacks. By now these hacks work without issues:


Baby Kaizo World
Climb The Tower
Cute Kaizo World
El Dorado
Grand Poo World 2
Invictus
Mahogen
Little Mario World
Peachy Moat World – any% (100% not yet tested)
Quickie World
Quickie World 2
Super Stacey World
Super Swunsh World 2
Shell's Retriever
Tebeo
The Joy of Kaizo

More hacks do work, however it is possible that some exits are not recognized correctly (leading to missing splits)

If you wish for a specific hack, let me know and I'll have a look on implementing it.

I'm always happy to hear about critic and suggestions to improving this tool!
